_comment: Every input and output path of this repository, read by paths.py (all scripts take --paths FILE).
Relative paths are taken from this repository: ../output is the output/ of TupleAnalysis when this
repository sits inside it. $VARIABLES and ~ are expanded. No production version in the file names.
output_dir:      where LaunchBkgPred.py files the predictions; read by systBckg.py and ShowPlots.py.
datasets:        the inputs of the prediction: step 1 file (with or without .root) and sampleType,
which selects the dE/dx calibration (data2024 | mc2024 | ttbar2024 | ...).
launch:          the datasets LaunchBkgPred.py runs on (--datasets overrides it).
dataset:         the dataset systBckg.py and ShowPlots.py work on (--dataset overrides it).
mc_stack:        weighted backgrounds stacked by PlottingMacro.py in MC mode.
signal_overlays: the three signal points drawn by PlottingMacro.py, with their legend labels.
Weighted files: TupleAnalysis python/Weight.py (see README section 5).
